hypothesis: Recent moves in traditional markets -- US stocks (S&P 500, Nasdaq), the US dollar index, gold, oil and the 10-year Treasury yield -- carry DIRECTIONAL information about Bitcoin's forward returns: stocks +, dollar -, others unspecified. Expected signs stated in advance.
acceptance_criterion: PRE-REGISTERED before running. Direction: Spearman(feature, return_H) block-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero with the same sign in BOTH exploration and validation. Magnitude: same, plus |rho| >= 0.10 both periods.

availability_check.source: Yahoo Finance chart API, daily bars, range=max: ^GSPC, ^IXIC, DX-Y.NYB, GC=F, CL=F, ^TNX; exchange timezone per series; dates converted to the exchange's trading date
availability_check.point_in_time_rule: a bar for trading date D is visible from D 22:00 UTC; last known value persists over weekends/holidays; hours-since-known recorded as macro_staleness_h. Tested (tests/test_macro_features.py: invisible at 21:00 UTC cutoff, visible at 22:00; garbled-future).
availability_check.unavailable: intraday history (not free beyond ~2 years); macro event calendars with trustworthy release timestamps (not free with history).

target.definition: signed forward return (direction) and absolute forward return (magnitude)
target.outcome: close of candle opening at as_of+H

near_misses.dxy_ret_5d: negative (dollar up -> BTC down) at every horizon in both periods; exploration intervals exclude zero at 1-72h; validation excludes zero only at 168h (-0.192 [-0.360, -0.007]) where exploration's upper bound is +0.003. Per-year sign at 24h flips (2019 +0.16, 2017 -0.09, 2020 -0.10).
near_misses.tnx_chg_5d: same pattern as the dollar (yields up -> BTC down): exploration excludes zero at 1-24h, validation only at 168h (-0.184 [-0.348, -0.009]); exploration upper bound at 168h +0.004.
near_misses.ndq_ret_1d: positive at all horizons in exploration (excludes zero at 1-168h, up to +0.13 at 168h) but ~0 in validation.

metrics.stocks: the expected positive stock co-movement appears in exploration for the Nasdaq only, and not at all in validation
metrics.magnitude: two 'consistent but below floor' (dxy_ret_1d 1h +0.05; gold_ret_5d 168h -0.09/-0.14); nothing usable

results: NO PASS. The dollar and Treasury yields show the expected NEGATIVE relationship with Bitcoin's weekly forward return in both periods, missing the pre-registered rule by a hair at 168h (exploration interval reaches +0.003 / +0.004) and clearly at shorter horizons. Per-year signs are unstable. Stock-market co-movement shows up only in the older period and only for the Nasdaq. Nothing is adopted. The dollar/yield weekly relationship is worth a confirmatory re-test later on the live record, alongside the E005 funding pattern.
consistent_across_time: Sign consistent between the two periods for dxy_ret_5d and tnx_chg_5d; not consistent year by year.
leakage_check: daily bars visible only from 22:00 UTC (conservative); tests pass; effect sizes are small, as expected for genuine features
overfitting_suspected: no -- nothing fitted; 65 tests, 0 passes, near-misses have the pre-stated signs
affected_design: No feature adopted. Add 'dxy_ret_5d and tnx_chg_5d at 168h (negative)' to the live-monitoring watch list with the funding pattern from E005.
notes: Phase 8 so far (E003-E006): 32 candidate features, one usable quantity (move size from volatility), zero usable directions.
